summary:
Space Mission Design Game

Our project, *Space Mission Design Game*, is an interactive educational game that allows players to experience the exciting process of planning and designing space missions. Players take on the role of space mission designers, making important decisions such as selecting destinations, choosing spacecraft, managing fuel, calculating distances, and planning mission resources.

The game transforms complex space science and mission-planning concepts into an engaging and accessible learning experience. By completing different challenges and overcoming mission obstacles, players develop problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills while learning about space exploration.

This project addresses the challenge by making space mission design more interactive, educational, and enjoyable. It encourages students and space enthusiasts to explore the science and technology behind real-world space missions and inspires the next generation of scientists, engineers, and explorers.
details:
Four destinations: Moon, Mars ,Venus and Jupiter.

Destination information and difficulty levels.

Three fictional rocket types.

Four science payload choices.

Adjustable fuel and mission budget.

Science mission objectives.

Animated launch countdown.

Mission success or failure results.

Mission scoring system.

Responsive design for laptop and mobile.

Coding language used was Java
